 Park Forest to Host LIHEAP Assistance Sessions for Eligible Cook County Residents
 eNews Park Forest 
 November 4, 2026 
 A father and son work on home finances. (By KayExam/peopleimages.com) 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X (Twitter) 
 Share on Pinterest 
 Share on LinkedIn 
 Park Forest, IL—(ENEWSPF)—As temperatures drop and heating costs rise, eligible Cook County residents can apply for financial assistance with their utility bills during a series of upcoming sessions at Park Forest Village Hall. The Village will host LIHEAP Assistance Sessions.
 The Village of Park Forest will host representatives from Apostolic Church, an approved energy service partnering site, on Nov. 10, 17, and 24 to help residents apply for the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, commonly…
